White Noise Generator

Generate white, pink and brown noise for sleep, focus and masking — with volume control and an auto-stop sleep timer.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick white, pink or brown noise.
  2. Set a comfortable volume.
  3. Optionally set a sleep timer.
  4. Press Play and relax.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which noise types are included?

White (even hiss), pink (softer, deeper) and brown (deep rumble). Pink is the most popular for sleep.

Is this real generated noise?

The noise is synthesized live with the Web Audio API — no audio files, no streaming.

Is there a sleep timer?

Yes — set 15, 30, 60 or 90 minutes and it fades out automatically.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — works on desktop and mobile browsers.
